d:
Anant sinh ki beti shivangi ki shadi men mehmanon ke lie 25 lakh se jyada mithaiyan taiyar ki jaengi.
Iske lie 1500 kvintal chini mangaee gaee hai aur 300-300 kvintal chini vale 5 trak ganv men utare ja rahe hain.
Dekhie shadi men mithaiyon ki taiyari ka pura intjam.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
